obligations.name: robert_channel_memberships
obligations.description: The conversation membership rows for whichever workspace member named Robert is intended, used to report which channels that person belongs to.

task_spec.text: Identify the workspace member named Robert and list the channels he currently belongs to.

access_plan: Use users.list (or users.conversations with a user filter) scoped to T01WORKSPACE to find workspace members whose real name starts with Robert, discovering both Robert Walsh and Robert Chen via their workspace membership; then use users.conversations/conversations.members for each candidate to enumerate their channel memberships, since no single stored field disambiguates which Robert was intended.
